instance_description:
Setting: A 2026 county election volunteer-services office in Fairmeadow, Colorado, supporting public information tables, poll-worker rooms, supply staging, and accessible voting-site preparation.
Scope: Recurring activities include poll-worker orientation support, voter-service clinic notes, polling-place accessibility walkthroughs, supply-kit tracking, language-access material coordination, ballot-drop signage checks, public meeting packets, and nonpartisan outreach drafts.
Resources: Empty reusable structures hold protagonist context, civic activity records, election-service materials, training notes, public-message drafts, and election-day checklists for later Scenario initialization.
Exclusions: This Instance excludes campaigning, legal interpretation, ballot handling decisions, voter-roll access, election outcome analysis, enforcement, and native app state such as calendars, email, or task lists.
personal_description:
Identity: Helena Maris Kestrel is a 52-year-old Fairmeadow resident and part-time nonpartisan volunteer liaison for the County Election Volunteer Services desk, using her full name as user_id.
Responsibilities: She prepares volunteer-facing materials, tracks public-service supplies, records training logistics, summarizes accessibility observations, and helps residents find official election-office resources.
Authority: She may maintain internal volunteer notes, draft neutral communications, organize approved training support, and spend only personally authorized funds from her own wallet.
Restrictions: She cannot access confidential voter systems, advise how to vote, interpret election law, certify results, handle voted ballots unsupervised, resolve eligibility disputes, or campaign for candidates or measures.
